I hear you. Two things before I take it further.

That BS-4 is your unit, built and allocated to your order, and it leaves our warehouse on October 31. Store credit keeps every dollar of the $681.97 and you could spend it today on something in stock, no waiting at all.

If you keep the order, I can also ask the team to refund $50 of it back to your original payment as a thank-you for staying with us.

Would you take that?
Can you cancel the order and refund the original payment?

Understood. Cancelling isn't something we normally do at our store, so a request like this has to go to a supervisor for review. I can't promise the outcome or a timeline.

Would you like me to put the request in?

The request is in with a supervisor now, and your order stays on hold so nothing ships in the meantime.

Stay in this chat if you can, one of the team will jump in here. If you step away, they'll come back to you by email at the address on the order.
